_comment: The reviewed inputs to the one-shot run, all three keys required. allowDrop: the exact text of each non-structure line the parser may drop. positional: 'above'/'below' references the plan review confirmed broken by the move; each is CHECKED by the script (right in the old order, wrong in the new). overrides: the resolution for every bullet that does not auto-assign (status not AGREE/PICKAXE), keyed by its exact head probe. The script refuses a missing, stale, duplicated or status-mismatched override, and one whose evidence commit does not resolve. Every entry was proposed in PLAN.md and reviewed at /pharn-dev-grill (GRILL.md, 'Override review').

Written in 126e2b3 (2026-06-23), the side-branch commit that first set SKILLS_VERSION to 1.0.0 and wrote the dated [1.0.0] heading, but under [Unreleased], not under [1.0.0]. On main's first-parent history it arrives with 1.0.0 at the merge 8753940, so its head maps to 1.0.0. [1.0.0] is kept byte-for-byte by instruction, and the entry's own author filed it as unreleased relative to [1.0.0], so it is filed under the next bump, 1.1.0 (87c98ff). The tension is named in this PR's CHANGELOG entry; folding it into [1.0.0] is left to the human.
